title: Regulated $L^2$ Norm on Certain Wild Higgs Bundles Over $\mathbb{CP}^1$
summary: We define and analyse certain $L^2$ norm on moduli space of Higgs bundles over $\mathbb{CP}^1$ with certain singularity. We prove that certain limit of our metrics here is the regulated $L^2$ norm proposed on the central fiber, first appearing in Fredrickson-Neitzke's work.
